description: Structured comparison data for the Side-by-Side Comparison Matrix interactive component. Five pre-configured comparisons with dimensions, verdicts, and context-dependent winner logic.

comparisons.title: Granite vs Quartz
comparisons.contextQuestion: What type of kitchen are you building?

dimensions.label: Type
dimensions.leftValue: Natural stone

dimensions.label: Porosity
dimensions.leftValue: Porous — absorbs liquids slowly if sealer is not applied
dimensions.rightValue: Non-porous in good-quality brands; does not absorb liquids

dimensions.label: Colour Range
dimensions.leftValue: Commonly darker colours — especially black as it hides stains better
dimensions.rightValue: Wide range of colours and patterns

dimensions.label: Best For
dimensions.leftValue: Indian households — heavy cooking and spice usage
dimensions.leftWinsWhen: Traditional Indian cooking, heavy spice usage

dimensions.label: Maintenance
dimensions.leftValue: Lower maintenance with darker colours

dimensions.label: Cost
dimensions.leftValue: More economical
dimensions.rightValue: Nearly double the cost of granite

dimensions.label: Durability
dimensions.leftValue: Durable and cost-effective
dimensions.rightValue: Durable but only from reputed brands

dimensions.label: Risk
dimensions.leftValue: Can stain without sealer
dimensions.note: Both have risks — sealer needed for granite, brand quality matters for quartz

budget.message: Granite is best for investment/rental projects — cost-effective and durable.

premium.message: Quartz is best for personal homes with adequate budget — but only from reputed brands.

comparisons.takeaway: Choose quartz if budget permits (nearly double the cost of granite) and only from reputed brands, as low-quality quartz can absorb liquids. Best for personal use. For investment projects, granite is cost-effective, durable, and works just as well.

comparisons.title: HDHMR vs Plywood
comparisons.contextQuestion: What are you building — shutters or carcass?

dimensions.label: Type
dimensions.leftValue: Engineered board made from wood fibres
dimensions.rightValue: Multiple layers of natural wood veneer

dimensions.label: Density / Surface
dimensions.leftValue: High density with smooth, uniform surface

dimensions.label: Moisture Resistance
dimensions.leftValue: Better moisture resistance than regular MDF; not for continuous water exposure
dimensions.rightValue: BWP grade handles continuous water; MR/BWR for moderate moisture

dimensions.label: Strength
dimensions.leftValue: Good — but less than plywood structurally

dimensions.label: Screw Holding
dimensions.leftValue: Good

dimensions.label: Best For
dimensions.leftValue: Shutters, CNC designs, painted/PU finishes
dimensions.rightValue: Carcass, kitchen cabinets, wardrobes, wet areas (BWP)
dimensions.leftWinsWhen: Building shutters — smooth surface with no undulations or wavy laminate
dimensions.rightWinsWhen: Building carcass — structural strength and better durability needed

dimensions.label: Surface Quality
dimensions.leftValue: Smooth — no undulations or wavy laminate
dimensions.rightValue: May have grain texture — depends on face veneer quality

dimensions.label: Cost
dimensions.leftValue: Cost-effective compared to plywood

dimensions.label: Limitations
dimensions.leftValue: Not for continuous water exposure areas
dimensions.rightValue: Face veneer quality varies by brand

shutters.message: HDHMR is recommended for shutters as it provides a smooth surface with no undulations or wavy laminate.

carcass.message: Plywood is ideal for the carcass due to its strong, multi-layered structure and better durability.

comparisons.takeaway: HDHMR is recommended for shutters as it provides a smooth surface with no undulations or wavy laminate. Plywood is ideal for the carcass due to its strong, multi-layered structure and better durability.

comparisons.title: MDF vs HDHMR
comparisons.contextQuestion: Is this for structural use or decorative CNC work?

dimensions.label: Density
dimensions.leftValue: Medium

dimensions.label: Moisture Resistance
dimensions.leftValue: Low — swells if exposed to water

dimensions.label: Strength
dimensions.leftValue: Weaker

dimensions.label: Screw Holding
dimensions.leftValue: Poor — may cause shutter issues over time

dimensions.label: Surface
dimensions.leftValue: Very smooth — ideal for paint and laminates

dimensions.label: Best For
dimensions.leftValue: Dry areas only: bedroom furniture, wall panels, CNC jaali panels, cut designs
dimensions.rightValue: Kitchen shutters, wardrobes, CNC designs, painted finishes, humid areas
dimensions.leftWinsWhen: CNC decorative jaali panels and cut designs ONLY
dimensions.rightWinsWhen: Structural use, kitchens, wardrobes, any moisture-prone area

dimensions.label: Cost
dimensions.leftValue: More economical

dimensions.label: Risk
dimensions.leftValue: Not recommended for carcasses; may cause shutter issues over time. Avoid kitchens, bathrooms, wet areas.

cncDecorative.message: MDF is acceptable for CNC decorative work (jaali panels, cut designs) in dry areas ONLY.

structural.message: HDHMR is a superior and more durable material — recommended wherever structural strength is needed.

kitchen.message: Use HDHMR only for kitchens. MDF is not suitable.

comparisons.takeaway: Use MDF only for CNC work such as jaali panels and cut designs. MDF has low moisture resistance and poor screw-holding capacity, so it is not recommended for carcasses and may cause shutter issues over time. HDHMR is a superior and more durable material and is recommended wherever possible.

comparisons.title: Sliding vs Swing Wardrobes
comparisons.contextQuestion: How much space do you have, and what's your hardware budget?

dimensions.label: Mechanism
dimensions.leftValue: Sliding channels (top/bottom rail)

dimensions.label: Space Requirement
dimensions.leftValue: No clearance needed — saves space
dimensions.rightValue: Requires clearance space in front for door opening

dimensions.label: Access
dimensions.leftValue: Limited — only one side can be opened at a time
dimensions.rightValue: Full access — entire wardrobe at once

dimensions.label: Hardware Quality Dependency
dimensions.leftValue: HIGH — poor channels cause wobbling, misalignment, getting stuck
dimensions.rightValue: Lower — hinges are durable and easy to replace

dimensions.label: Maintenance
dimensions.leftValue: Higher if inferior hardware is used

dimensions.label: Load Distribution
dimensions.leftValue: On tracks — can misalign over time
dimensions.rightValue: Better load distribution on carcass and shutters

dimensions.label: Best For
dimensions.leftValue: Compact bedrooms
dimensions.leftWinsWhen: Bedroom is compact OR premium hardware budget is available

dimensions.label: Risk
dimensions.leftValue: Poor-quality sliding channels = major long-term frustration

compactSpace.message: Sliding is the only space-saving option — but ONLY with high-quality hardware.

adequateSpace.message: Swing wardrobes are more reliable, easier to maintain, and structurally stable over time.

comparisons.takeaway: Choose sliding wardrobes only with high-quality hardware, especially for long-term use. Swing wardrobes are more reliable, easier to maintain, and structurally stable over time.

comparisons.title: German vs Indian Accessories
comparisons.contextQuestion: Is this a long-term personal home or a budget/investment project?

dimensions.label: Durability
dimensions.leftValue: Higher durability
dimensions.rightValue: Good functionality for regular residential use

dimensions.label: Engineering
dimensions.leftValue: Precision engineering

dimensions.label: Load Bearing
dimensions.leftValue: Advanced load-bearing and motion technology

dimensions.label: Soft-Close
dimensions.leftValue: Smoother soft-close mechanisms

dimensions.label: Longevity
dimensions.leftValue: Better performance, especially in kitchens and high-usage areas

dimensions.label: Service
dimensions.leftValue: May need specialist service

dimensions.label: Cost
dimensions.leftValue: Higher cost due to superior engineering and testing standards

dimensions.label: Best For
dimensions.leftValue: Long-term personal homes, premium kitchens
dimensions.leftWinsWhen: Long-term personal home, premium kitchen, prioritizing longevity
dimensions.rightWinsWhen: Rental investment, budget-sensitive project, prioritizing initial savings

premium.message: For long-term use and premium performance, German-based accessories are recommended.

budget.message: For budget-controlled or investment projects, Indian-based accessories offer reliable value.

comparisons.takeaway: For long-term use and premium performance, German-based accessories are recommended. For budget-controlled or investment projects, Indian-based accessories offer reliable value.
